resources.name: OpsPilot
resources.description: Requests for the OpsPilot API. Start the server with `npm run dev` first. Full API description: docs/openapi.yaml.

resources.name: Success (200)
resources.description: Requests that run the agent. Each one calls the model, so it needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY and can take from a few seconds to over a minute.

resources.name: Errors (4xx)
resources.description: Requests that the server rejects before running the agent. They are fast and do not call the model.

resources.name: List firing alerts (forced react)
resources.description: Read-only question with the strategy forced. Expect 200, stopReason completed, a route event with source override and no router call, and a trace with list_alerts.

resources.name: Router decides (message only)
resources.description: No strategy: the router chooses. Expect 200 and exactly one route event with source router (or fallback if the router failed), then the chosen strategy's events. Every trace event has a node. WRITES DATA when the router picks plan-execute: run `npm run seed` to reset.

resources.name: Open sev2 incident (reflect)
resources.description: WRITES DATA: the agent opens a real incident in data/db.json. Run `npm run seed` to reset. reflect: true is an alias for strategy "reflect" (react plus the critic), so the trace has a route event with source override and critique events, and the call takes longer.

resources.name: Multi-step task (forced plan-execute)
resources.description: WRITES DATA: opens an incident for the oldest firing alert, then counts what is left. The trace has a route event with source override, then a plan event. Plan-execute with critique is no longer reachable through /chat.

resources.name: 400 - reflect with another strategy
resources.description: reflect: true only combines with strategy reflect. Expect 400 invalid_body with an issue on the path ["reflect"].

resources.name: 400 - blank message
resources.description: message must have at least one character after trimming. Expect 400 invalid_body with an issue on ["message"].

resources.name: 400 - body is not JSON
resources.description: The header says JSON but the body is not. Expect 400 invalid_body with one issue whose path is empty.

resources.name: 400 - missing JSON content-type
resources.description: Valid JSON text, but sent as text/plain, so the server never reads it. Expect 400 invalid_body. This is the usual cause of a 400 when calling with curl and no -H header.

resources.name: 422 - unknown strategy
resources.description: Strategy names are case sensitive, so React is unknown. Expect 422 unknown_strategy with knownStrategies listing the valid names.

resources.name: 404 - other path
resources.description: Only POST /chat exists. Any other path or method gets Express's default 404 page, not a JSON body.

resources.name: Follow-up in a conversation (react)
resources.description: Send the first request with no conversationId, copy conversationId from the reply into the conversation_id variable of the Base Environment, then send this one. Expect 200, the same conversationId, and metrics.historyMessages 2 (4 after the next one). The conversation survives a server restart.

resources.name: 400 - conversationId is not a UUID
resources.description: The id must be a UUID. Expect 400 invalid_body with an issue on the path conversationId. Nothing ran.

resources.name: 404 - unknown conversation
resources.description: A well-formed UUID that names no conversation. Expect 404 conversation_not_found with conversationId. The agent does not run and no conversation is created.
